description: issue #932, the EXECUTE half of the pair whose check half is `command-body-no-value-check` — the same source, so the two stages are pinned to the same answer for one program: the same `ol-no-value` code, the same `form` param, and the same line/column range, each fixture's span naming its own document. The runtime used to carry a verbatim copy of the checker's three-name command list, so BOTH stages were silent here: agreement on the wrong answer. The trace stops at the `instruction` event for the assignment: the body's final statement is a Command, so `runComprehensionBody` reports no-value for the first element before evaluating it, and no `move`/`draw-segment` event is ever emitted — the same order the `print` spelling follows. Issue #815: `execute()` now runs Layer 1 and Layer 2 before Phase 2 and refuses a program carrying an `error`-severity finding (`spec/execution-model.md:659-664`), so no event is emitted and the diagnostic delivered here is the CHECK's. The runtime's own copy of the rule still exists and still runs — under the `runUnchecked` opt-out — and is collapsed into the check's by the de-duplication rule (`spec/execution-model.md:741-748`), which is why only one report survives and it reads `stage: "semantic"`.
